item.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 3.5 Sonnet
item.description: Anthropic announced Claude 3.5 Sonnet, setting new industry benchmarks for coding and tool use. The model is 2x faster than Claude 3 Opus and excels at complex codebase refactoring.

item.title: VS Code Releases Native AI Agent Workspace Mode
item.description: VS Code 1.95 introduces an integrated terminal agent that interacts directly with git repositories, runs lint checks, and automatically fixes compiler errors.
